sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)
NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: A vessel contains $0.15\ \mathrm{m^3}$ of a gas at pressure $8$ bar and temperature $140\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ with $c_p=3R$ and $c_v=2R$. It is expanded adiabatically till pressure falls to $1$ bar. The work done during this process is ______ $\mathrm{kJ}$. ($R$ is gas constant)
stem.hi: एक पात्र में $0.15\ \mathrm{m^3}$ गैस है, जिसका दाब $8$ बार और ताप $140\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ है, तथा $c_p=3R$ और $c_v=2R$ हैं। इसे रुद्धोष्म रूप से तब तक प्रसारित किया जाता है जब तक दाब घटकर $1$ बार न हो जाए। इस प्रक्रम में किया गया कार्य ______ $\mathrm{kJ}$ है। ($R$ गैस नियतांक है)

feynman.en: For an adiabatic change $PV^\gamma$ stays constant and the work is $\frac{P_1V_1-P_2V_2}{\gamma-1}$. The temperature is not needed.
feynman.hi: रुद्धोष्म परिवर्तन में $PV^\gamma$ स्थिर रहता है और कार्य $\frac{P_1V_1-P_2V_2}{\gamma-1}$ है। ताप की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
